I don't have today's price move data for MPC, so I can't tell you what direction the stock moved or by how much. Without that, I can't explain the day's specific price action.

What I can see is that MPC just reported quarterly earnings and announced a leadership change on the same day—both potential movers—and the broader refining environment shows strong indicators: refineries are running hot at 92.8% capacity, oil prices are elevated (US crude at $103/barrel), and storage levels are moderate, which typically supports refiner margins. However, none of this tells me whether the stock went up or down today.
